parts.script:
Alice: Hey, Ben! Have you thought about what we should do this weekend? 
Ben: I was thinking we could go hiking at Pine Valley. It’s supposed to be beautiful this time of year. 
Alice: That sounds great! How long do you think the hike will take? 
Ben: Probably around four to five hours. We should leave early in the morning to avoid the heat. 
Alice: Good idea! Should we pack lunch? 
Ben: Definitely. I can make sandwiches, and you could bring some fruits? 
Alice: That works! Do you have enough water bottles? 
Ben: I think so, but I'll check just in case. We should also take some sunscreen. 
Alice: Right, the last time we went hiking, I got sunburned. And what about the camera? 
Ben: Oh, yes! Let’s not forget that. We’ll want to take pictures of the scenery. 
Alice: Perfect! So, we meet at your place at 7 AM? 
Ben: Sounds like a plan. See you then! 
Alice: See you!

questions.question: Where are Alice and Ben planning to go this weekend?
questions.explanation: They mentioned going hiking at Pine Valley.

questions.question: Complete the form. Write no more than TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: They decided to meet at 7 AM and Ben will make sandwiches.

questions.question: What should Alice bring to the hike?
questions.explanation: Alice agreed to bring fruits for their lunch.
